calls.text: {"meetingId": "409", "tickets": [{"title": "Obtain missing tax records for Anika Pebblefizz’s 2022 notice review", "text": "Obtain the missing Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary for Beren Nettlewhisk’s review of Anika Pebblefizz’s 2022 federal and state returns.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-18", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the notice packet available to Apricot Compass lacked the Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary Beren requested; the agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by April 18, 2024."}, {"title": "Reconcile the Velvet Acorn dividend variance", "text": "Reconcile the $14,860 of ordinary dividends reported in the IRS correspondence with the $7,440 shown in the return worksheet reviewed during the call.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-24", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the IRS correspondence lists $14,860 of ordinary dividends from the Velvet Acorn taxable account, while the return worksheet reviewed during the call shows $7,440 for the same income category; resolution of the custodian income variance is needed by April 24, 2024."}]}
